title: Cloud Hypervisor enclave transcript writer fails session-log preflight
symptoms: session-log preflight fails before the enclave engine launches
conditions: A static public-only eligible Cloud Hypervisor invocation retains a protected operation-error for preflight-session-log
The legacy session-state ownership or virtio-fs mapping does not match the fixed trusted entrypoint writer identity
rootCause: The trusted transcript writer previously encountered storage owned for a different identity, while virtio-fs squashed guest root into the non-root engine identity. Append-open preflight failed before any inference or engine exit.

probe.expect: Read only the already projected, credential-redacted operation/category/errno event. Missing transcript evidence is not success and does not by itself prove a credential problem.

action: Use matching staging and guest code from the writer-identity fix: root-owned 0700 session-state, 0600 transcript, exact trusted transcript export and append-open validation. Engine children remain permanently non-root. Do not chmod arbitrary host paths, broaden exports or disable root squashing globally. Live VM/provider acceptance remains separate.
